content.statement: A matter which has been directly and substantially in issue in a former suit between the same parties, decided by a competent court on merits, cannot be tried again.
content.summary: A matter which has been directly and substantially in issue in a former suit between the same parties, decided by a competent court on merits, cannot be tried again.
elements: Same parties or privies litigating under the same title
Matter directly and substantially in issue
